name: Perry
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Perry, GA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Perry, Georgia for 2026: a tree lighting, the Christmas parade, a pajama bash and the Buzzard Drop, with dates checked.
lede: Perry keeps its Christmas season in Historic Downtown Perry, with a tree lighting, a parade, a pajama night and a New Year's Eve countdown made for kids.
celebrates: The City of Perry and its Main Street program run most of the holiday season in Historic Downtown Perry. The season opens with Small Business Saturday and the Tree Lighting Ceremony on November 28, followed by the Perry Christmas Parade on December 5 and the new Pajama Holiday Bash on December 11. It ends with the Perry Buzzard Drop on December 31, which includes a Kiddie Countdown at 9 pm. The city says its events are funded through sponsorships, in-kind donations and hotel and motel occupancy tax revenue, and the Downtown Perry Farmers Market runs every Saturday from 9 am to 1 pm.
lastyear: Last December the Perry Christmas Parade took place on Saturday, December 6, 2025, with the theme Christmas at the Movies. Visit Perry's guide described 86 entries and performances by the Perry High and Veterans High marching bands, and said each float donated a toy to Toys for Tots, with more than 90 toys in total. Santa and Mrs. Claus closed the parade on their sleigh. Road construction forced a different route that year, and the Pancake Breakfast with Santa at the Perry Events Center took place the same morning.
facts: Visit Perry calls the Buzzard Drop nationally recognized and says it has been a three-time USA TODAY 10 Best nominee. The city calls it Middle Georgia's largest New Year's Eve celebration, and its listing includes a Kiddie Countdown at 9 pm so young children can join in before bedtime. Visit Perry's December guide also describes a long-standing neighborhood light display at 823 Ball Street, where kids look for Santa flying an airplane. Perry's downtown address for events is 800 Carroll Street, the city's Historic Downtown.
trains: We did not find a holiday train ride in Perry for 2026. Visit Perry's guide to last year's Winter Wonderland downtown described a trackless train for kids, but the city's 2026 pages do not list that event. Near Perry, the Museum of Aviation in Warner Robins shows its Planes and Trains Model Railroad Display from November 22 to 29, 2026, and it is listed on our Warner Robins page. Warner Robins also lists trackless train rides at its December 1 tree lighting.
traditions: Small Business Saturday and Tree Lighting
On November 28 downtown Perry holds Small Business Saturday from 10 am to 6 pm, and the city lists the tree lighting from 5:30 to 6:30 pm on the City Hall Lawn.
The parade steps off in Historic Downtown Perry on Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 10 am.
A new Friday night in downtown Perry on December 11 where families wear Christmas pajamas, eat from food trucks and shop late.
The New Year's Eve party on December 31 includes a Kiddie Countdown at 9 pm before the midnight buzzard drop and fireworks.
Visit Perry describes a long-standing neighborhood display at 823 Ball Street with Santa flying an airplane.
kidfact: In Perry, New Year's Eve has a countdown for kids at 9 pm, so children can cheer at the buzzard drop's party without staying up until midnight.
faq: Historic Downtown Perry hosts a tree lighting on November 28, the Perry Christmas Parade on December 5, a Pajama Holiday Bash on December 11 and the Perry Buzzard Drop on December 31. The city also runs a free Saturday farmers market from 9 am to 1 pm at 1000 Ball Street.
When is the Perry Christmas Parade in 2026?

The City of Perry lists the Perry Christmas Parade for Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 10 am in Historic Downtown Perry. Our event listing links to the city's events page, which also has the registration link for groups that want to take part in the parade.
Is there a Christmas event for kids in Perry on a Friday night?

Yes. The Pajama Holiday Bash is on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 6 to 9 pm in Historic Downtown Perry. The city says it is free to attend, with food trucks, extended late-night shopping and a Christmas pajama dress code for the whole family.
Is there a New Year's Eve event for kids in Perry?

Yes. The Perry Buzzard Drop on December 31, 2026, runs from 8 pm to midnight, and the city lists a Kiddie Countdown at 9 pm for families with little ones. It is free to attend and held in Historic Downtown Perry, with fireworks at midnight.
Who can I ask about Perry's holiday events?

The City of Perry lists its Downtown Manager at (478) 988-2730 for downtown events and its Special Events Administrator at (478) 988-2758. The city also notes that event dates and times are subject to change, so check its events pages before you go.
